# Fixtures

These synthetic illustrations were generated locally by `scripts/create-fixtures.py`. They are original project test data, released under CC0-1.0. No user photos or external image copyrights. `photo.jpg` tests the JPEG path; it is an illustration, not a claim of photographic restoration quality. Reproduction needs Pillow (development only, no runtime dependency).

Covers: RGB, alpha, static WebP, animated WebP/GIF, large/maximum/narrow/non-tile-multiple images, EXIF rotation/mirroring, black legitimate result, corrupt PNG and unsupported SVG.
